meta.note: Officers and directors of the 200 largest FDIC-insured institutions (by total assets, FDIC BankFind, report date 06/30/2026). Positions are as reported by each person on SEC Forms 3/4/5 (Section 16 insiders) filed since 2025-05-01, with the most recent filing date; names appear as filed (surname first). Compensation is the principal executive officer total compensation from the latest DEF 14A pay-versus-performance XBRL. Multiple bank charters under one parent share the parent's insiders.
